speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates

main.name: Main thread
main.description: Orchestrator only: route a request, specify it, build it in parallel worktrees, review it locally and open one PR per batch

write-spec.name: Write or amend a spec
write-spec.description: Grill, simplify (ponytail), then Spec Kit specify/clarify/plan/tasks into the spec's tree path

verify.name: Verify
verify.description: Run one named verification suite (npm run verify:* and friends) and report its exit code

create-project.name: Create an Averlo project
create-project.description: Create an independent project with the published create-averlo initializer and verify it

publish.name: Publish an Averlo project
publish.description: Publish a verified local project to private GitLab and Vercel production, with confirmed targets and collision checks

backport.name: Backport from a child project
backport.description: Bring something a generated project did into the template: diff from the source SHA, port rules not values, record repo and SHA in the PR
